derivation:
by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty Ω with h | h
  · simp [Measure.eq_zero_of_isEmpty μ]
  · simpa only [condExpKernel_apply_eq_condDistrib, MeasurableSpace.comap_id, id_eq] using condExp_ae_eq_integral_condDistrib_id (measurable_id.mono le_rfl inf_le_right) hf_int
